comment: Reference GPUs of the weak-GPU estimate of `bench --graph`. Specifications from vendor pages (read 2026-11-27); `basis` says what is listed and what is derived. Peak figures, not measured throughput.

basis.fp32: Derived: 8960 CUDA cores x 2.45 GHz boost x 2 (multiply-add). Both inputs listed.

basis.bandwidth: Derived: dual channel DDR4-3200, 2 x 8 B x 3200 MT/s. The page lists the memory types and 2 channels, not a bandwidth; with LPDDR4x-4267 it would be 68.3 GB/s (the lower one is used). Shared with the CPU.
basis.fp32: Derived: 96 EU x 16 FLOP/clk (1536 FLOP/clk multiply-add for the 96 EU of Xe-LP) x 1.30 GHz max dynamic frequency.

basis.bandwidth: Listed: 76.8 GB/s max memory bandwidth. Shared with the CPU.
basis.fp32: Derived: 32 EU x 16 FLOP/clk x 1.50 GHz. The per EU rate is the Xe-LP one of the guide; the product page does not name the architecture.

basis.bandwidth: Derived: one channel of DDR5/LPDDR5 4800 MT/s, 8 B x 4800 MT/s. The page lists the speed and 1 channel, not a bandwidth. Shared with the CPU.
basis.fp32: Derived: 24 EU x 16 FLOP/clk x 0.75 GHz. The per EU rate is the Xe-LP one of the guide; the product page does not name the architecture.
